title: Same Man. Same Night. 365 Days Later.

items.label: Establishing
items.visual: Dark bedroom at night; one man on the bed edge, tired

items.label: "Same man… won't recognize each other."
items.visual: Push-in; frame splits on "splits" (src ~11.5); right: hand to phone, left: hand to book (src ~13.4–18.0); both look up
items.sfx: Whoosh on "splits"; unlock tap (src 14.8); book thump (src 17.3)
items.music: Piano; warm/cold themes enter on their sides

items.label: Title
items.visual: Title card

items.label: "The phone feels good… Ten pages feel like a hundred." (cut estimated, check by ear)
items.visual: Right: thumb scrolls, sparkle pop per swipe, small smile. Left: eyes on one line, glance at clock, yawn
items.sfx: Swipes; reward pops (src 27.1, 28.0, 28.9); clock tick; yawn

items.label: READER (muttering): "Who even reads anymore…"
items.visual: Reader sighs, keeps going

items.label: Establishing
items.visual: Night, both halves, lamp vs phone glow

items.label: "Just five more minutes… mostly to prove he can."
items.visual: Clock jumps 23:40 → 02:00; book shuts; relaxed vs bored; receipt starts printing on "the bill comes later"; night two: book stays shut a beat; night three: on the bus
items.sfx: Clock spin (src 49.5); book shut (src 52.9); receipt whirr (src 67.6); bus engine (src 72.7)

items.label: Establishing
items.visual: Morning light

items.label: "Day five… becoming a pattern."
items.visual: Right: phone at alarm; fast cuts breakfast/bathroom/bed with screen. Left: same chair, same mug; page counter 10 → 50
items.sfx: Spoon clink, tap, sheets; tea pour (src 91.9); page turns

items.label: M1 Days blur
items.visual: Split, days 6–20: identical days cut faster vs same chair every evening, page counter climbs
items.sfx: Swipe loop speeding up vs page turns on the beat

items.label: Establishing
items.visual: Kitchen, evening

items.label: "Day 21, something feels off… Small things annoy him." (cut estimated)
items.visual: Right: dark circles, slumped at the table, phone in hand

items.label: MOM: "Your food's getting cold…" SCROLLER (snapping): "I said I'm coming!"
items.visual: Mom steps back; he doesn't look up

items.label: "He snaps at his mother… The hard part is getting easier."
items.visual: He sits alone in the glow, receipt prints a line; left: looks up surprised, counter 210 → 230; lamp off, sleeps
items.sfx: Receipt whirr; page flutter; lamp click (src ~135.5)

items.label: Establishing
items.visual: Office, morning

items.label: "Then the book starts leaking… He thinks before he reacts." (cut estimated)
items.visual: He speaks calmly in a meeting; pauses before replying

items.label: COLLEAGUE: "Since when do you talk like that?" READER (smiling): "Since chapter twelve."
items.visual: Colleague raises an eyebrow

items.label: "He wakes up a little earlier… changing the others."
items.visual: Sunrise, curtains open, book on nightstand, plant grows

items.label: Establishing
items.visual: Split again, same night

items.label: "Day 90… it's the other way around."
items.visual: Right: same shot as night one. Left: book stack, notes, upright. Halves swap brightness on "other way around"

items.label: Brightness swap
items.visual: The halves trade brightness, then settle with the reader brighter

items.label: Establishing
items.visual: Restaurant at night

items.label: "Month six… Two hours feel like 20 minutes."
items.visual: Invite on both phones; right: cancels from bed; left: dinner, laughing, listening
items.sfx: Message ping (src 178.0); typing + send (src 183.5); cutlery, laughter

items.label: FRIEND: "When did you get so interesting?" READER (laughing): "Somewhere around book nine."
items.visual: Friend laughs, raises a glass

items.label: "Meanwhile, the scroller watches… keeps scrolling."
items.visual: Dinner photo in his feed; heart pops; thumb keeps going

items.label: M2 Seasons
items.visual: Split, days 180–300: seasons outside both windows; book stack grows vs screen-time counter climbs, he never moves
items.sfx: Page turns, rain, wind vs swipe loop, counter ticks

items.label: Establishing
items.visual: Scroller in bed, late night, phone above his face

items.label: "He knows something is wrong… He changed nothing."
items.visual: Search bar types "how to fix your life"; thumbnails scroll; 40 MIN counter; push on his empty face
items.music: Cold theme; drops out after "changed nothing"

items.label: Silent beat
items.visual: Phone glow flickers on his face

items.label: Establishing
items.visual: Glass-walled manager's room

items.label: "Month 11… stays calm under pressure." (cut estimated)
items.visual: Manager waves him in; he stands, surprised

items.label: MANAGER: "We want you to lead it." READER: "…Me?" MANAGER: "You've changed this year."
items.visual: Handshake

items.label: "Nobody saw the 10 pages a night… where it came from."
items.visual: Flash cuts: chair, lamp, tea; his quiet smile

items.label: Establishing
items.visual: Same room as S01, split

items.label: "Day 365… one night at a time."
items.visual: Mirror of S01; counters 20+ BOOKS vs 1,000+ HOURS (3 h a day × 365); receipt prints its total and tears; one upright, one slumped

items.label: Silent beat
items.visual: Hold on both faces

items.label: M3 One night at a time
items.visual: 365 nights flip like a flipbook on both sides
items.sfx: Page flutter vs swipe flutter, accelerating

items.label: Establishing
items.visual: Night; the divider glows faintly

items.label: "That night… he turns it face down." (cut estimated)
items.visual: Divider fades; he sees his other self; phone turns over

items.label: SCROLLER (whisper): "Okay. Ten pages."
items.visual: He reaches for the book

items.label: "He opens a book… on night one."
items.visual: Eyes back and forth on one line; cold grade warms to gold

items.label: Beat
items.visual: Both halves at night: one reading, one about to

items.label: "The phone gives you a good night… which one will you pick up?"
items.visual: Split one last time; both hands hover; cut to black before he chooses

items.label: End card
items.visual: End card
items.onScreenText: What's the last book you finished?
